receipts.detail: every cohort member of every captured generation gets W (capture) -> handoff observed -> barrier release -> READY instants with deltas from W over the recorded 07-13-07 excerpt
each generation's classified outcome, the closure verdict, the failure reasons and completionMs are copied from the closure analyzer, never re-derived (single classification owner)
the CLI reads report.json and full-logs/ from one per-run report directory and prints the per-node timeline and classified outcome as text and as --json
the projection exposes no pass/fail field of its own at the run, generation or node level beyond the analyzer's copied verdict
the closure analyzer still classifies the recorded run on its own: completed + retained_uncompleted_at_teardown, closure failed
package.json exposes analyze:formation-release-phases and the npm run commands index lists it
two projections (and renderings) of the identical recorded run are identical
